title: DiSCO: Defending text-to-image generation through distribution-guided contrastive prompt optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.17067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As text-to-image generative models advance, they raise critical safety concerns, particularly the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content such as violence and nudity, further exacerbated by red-teaming adversarial attacks. Existing defenses predominantly operate under white-box assumptions, relying on text encoder optimization, weight editing, or inference-time intervention, and fundamentally cannot scale to proprietary models. Black-box alternatives based on LLM prompt rewriting offer broader applicability, yet fail in a critical regime we identify as the \textit{benign adversarial} problem: prompts that are linguistically safe but still trigger harmful generation due to the model's learned data distribution. We propose DiSCO, a zero-shot, strictly black-box defense that operates entirely at the prompt level as a plug-and-play module, requiring no model retraining, fine-tuning, or access to model internals. translated_title: DiSCO：通过分布引导的对比提示优化防御文本到图像生成
translated_abstract: 随着文本到图像生成模型的进步，它们引发了关键的安全问题，尤其是生成暴力、裸体等不宜工作（NSFW）内容，并且红色团队对抗攻击进一步加剧了这一问题。现有防御主要在白盒假设下运作，依赖文本编码器优化、权重编辑或推理时干预，从根本上无法扩展到专有模型。基于LLM提示重写的黑盒替代方案提供了更广泛的适用性，但在我们识别为“良性对抗”的关键场景中失败：即提示在语言上安全，但由于模型学习的数据分布，仍会触发有害生成。我们提出DiSCO，一种零样本、严格黑盒的防御方法，完全在提示级别作为即插即用模块运作，无需模型重训练、微调或访问模型内部。DiSCO执行分布引导的对比优化，以调整提示，使其在保持语义的同时避免触发有害生成。
tldr: DiSCO提出了一种零样本、严格黑盒的提示级防御方法，通过分布引导的对比优化解决良性对抗问题，无需模型内部访问即可防止NSFW内容生成。
en_tdlr: DiSCO proposes a zero-shot, strictly black-box prompt-level defense that uses distribution-guided contrastive optimization to address the benign adversarial problem, preventing NSFW content generation without model internal access.
